I read both pages through text extraction and a render at 100 DPI. The earlier draft was written before I had read the pages. This brief replaces it, and the table matches the extracted text and the render.

**What the document does not contain**
- There are no topic labels, explanations, student answers, scores or marks (pp. 1–2). The only content is the letter key.
- The only marking is underlining in the render. On p. 1, Q09 (answer A) is underlined, and the document gives no reason (p. 1).
- Answers go up to E, so at least Q17, 21, 38 and 42 have five options (p. 1).

**Page 2 is a different exam**
- Page 2 is a separate key, "SIMULADO ENGENHARIA DA COMPUTAÇÃO" (Computer Engineering) (p. 2). Use p. 1 for Ciência da Computação.
- Its answers match p. 1 except for these eight questions (Ciência → Engenharia): Q29 C→D, Q30 C→A, Q31 C→A, Q32 D→B, Q34 A→C, Q36 A→B, Q39 B→A, Q40 A→D (pp. 1–2).
- On p. 2, Q29, 30, 31, 32, 34, 36, 39, 40 and 42 are underlined. Eight of these are the questions that differ. Q42 (E) is underlined but has the same answer on both keys (p. 2).

Pages consulted: 1, 2
